newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-PSV WINGER ZENDEN GETS FIRST DUTCH CALL-UP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSV WINGER ZENDEN GETS FIRST DUTCH CALL-UP.

text.p: Dutch coach Guus Hiddink called up PSV winger Boudewijn Zenden for the first time on Thursday in his squad for the World Cup qualifier against San Marino next Wednesday.
Hiddink chose Zenden and Twente Enschede striker John Bosman, who played his last international two and a half years ago, for the group seven game.
They replace injured strikers Patrick Kluivert of Ajax Amsterdam and Youri Mulder of UEFA Cup finalists Schalke 04.
Dennis Bergkamp, who missed the Netherlands' 1-0 defeat away to Turkey in their last match because of his fear of flying, returns to the squad. He will travel to Italy by car.
The Netherlands, who beat San Marino 4-0 at home, lead group seven with 12 points from five matches.
Goalkeepers: Edwin van der Sar (Ajax), Ed de Goey (Feyenoord).
Defenders: Frank de Boer (Ajax), Arthur Numan, Jaap Stam (both PSV), Michael Reiziger (AC Milan), Ferdi Vierklau (Vitesse).
Midfielders: Ronald de Boer, Richard Witschge (both Ajax), Giovanni van Bronckhorst (Feyenoord), Clarence Seedorf (Real Madrid), Wim Jonk (PSV), Aron Winter (Inter Milan).
Strikers: Marc Overmars (Ajax), Boudewijn Zenden (PSV), Dennis Bergkamp (Arsenal), Pierre van Hooijdonk (Nottingham Forest), John Bosman (FC Twente).
